consumerTrace.observation: Polls the active connection, asks FUN_00DA25D0 to process the next record, and retries setup only while connection+0x04 remains zero.
Parses the clear subrecord header. Type 0x000A is copied as a complete 0x0290-byte subrecord only when its declared length is exact.
Case 10 invokes LobbyCryptEngine vtable slot 4 with the copied subrecord and a stack-local 0x38-byte setup result, then calls FUN_00DB34A0.
Derives the local Blowfish key, decrypts all 0x280 payload bytes at subrecord+0x10, copies payload+0x00 as one u32 into setup+0x10, and transiently copies payload+0x0C..+0x2B into setup+0x14..+0x33.

When the current assigned value is zero, requires setup+0x10 to be nonzero, stores it, and dispatches only that u32 to the connection callbacks. It does not read the transient payload+0x0C..+0x2B copy.
Logs an entity-ID assignment and writes the supplied u32 to active connection+0x04.
